baseline_models.focus_anchor: The isolated definite noun الحاقة at word 1, from ح ق ق.
baseline_models.mechanism: The title nominalizes what stands fixed in correspondence with reality; before any context, its one-word isolation lets actuality itself function as the announcement.

activation_trace.role: Fixed correspondence with reality supplies the title's contrastive force against falsehood.

changed_reading.after: The fixed actuality that stands against whatever is false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ح ق ق noun الحاقة can gather the root's senses of becoming due and possessing a claim.
baseline_models.mechanism: The title can name not only what is true but what has become binding and collectible, so inevitability has the pressure of an obligation or entitlement rather than bare futurity.

activation_trace.role: Due obligation and deserved claim make the announced reality binding rather than merely possible.
A particular owned right lets the title carry the pressure of a claim awaiting settlement.

changed_reading.before: The event that will inevitably happen.
changed_reading.after: The due claim whose time for enforcement has arrived.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The title's ح ق ق root includes both contest over right and the act of making truth stand.
baseline_models.mechanism: الحاقة can be processive: rival claims meet, then reality itself verifies and manifests which claim holds. The title thus permits an adjudicating event alongside the simpler event-name reading.

activation_trace.role: Contesting claims supply the opposed positions that require adjudication.
Establishing and displaying truth supplies the event's resolving operation.

changed_reading.before: A true event as a static object of belief.
changed_reading.after: An adjudicating occurrence that makes the true claim stand.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Two material branches of ح ق ق describe tight construction and an exact joint, socket, or middle.
baseline_models.mechanism: The title can evoke a reality in which statements, acts, and places lock into exact correspondence, as tightly made fabric or a joint seated in its proper socket.

activation_trace.role: Tight construction in fabric or speech supplies a model of internally coherent actuality.
Exact fitting at a joint or socket supplies the model of each thing meeting its proper place.

changed_reading.after: The exact fitting of reality, where every element meets its proper counterpart.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ح ق ق inventory includes an animal reaching due bearing age and bodily or seasonal completion.
baseline_models.mechanism: الحاقة can signal a threshold that has ripened: conditions have reached full strength and are now fit to bear what becomes due.

activation_trace.role: Reaching the due age for bearing supplies the threshold of readiness and capacity.
Fulfilled bodily or seasonal condition makes the event a culmination rather than an arbitrary interruption.

changed_reading.after: A due threshold reached when the whole condition has ripened.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ح ق ق inventory links a straight penetrating thrust with an exhausting pace that overburdens the traveler.
baseline_models.mechanism: The title can carry a directional and kinetic force: actuality advances without deviation, passes beyond the surface, and forces passage through a pace the weak cannot sustain.

activation_trace.role: A straight thrust that reaches the interior supplies direct, non-glancing penetration.
The back-exhausting hard pace supplies sustained pressure during the event's arrival.

changed_reading.before: An event that merely becomes present.
changed_reading.after: A straight, interior-reaching arrival whose pace cannot be evaded or comfortably borne.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated title is enclosed by questions about what it is and what could make the addressee know it. This revises fixed actuality into an occurrence whose arrival supplies the knowledge that its name initially withholds.

activation_trace.role: Making truth stand is the focus-side operation that can turn obscurity into disclosure.
The repeated truth-establishing branch makes the interrogated name function as a withheld manifestation.
Knowledge and discernment supply the explicit epistemic gap that the event must close.

structural_cues: The one-word title is repeated in 69:2 and 69:3 inside two ma interrogatives.
The cognition root returns negatively in 69:26, linking not-knowing with failed reckoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, interrogation, and a knowledge branch; I infer that occurrence produces disclosure, while the live alternative is rhetorical magnification without a causal epistemic arrow.

changed_reading.before: The fixed reality is already a concept one can define.
changed_reading.after: The fixed reality is initially cognition-breaking and finally makes itself known by occurring.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial is followed by a second event-name built from collision and auditory rebuke. The title's contested truth therefore becomes a verdict delivered as impact: false claims are not only contradicted but struck into experienced refutation.

activation_trace.role: Mutually contested claims provide the dispute that calls for a decisive answer.
Straight penetration gives the verdict a force that reaches beyond surface denial.
Contradiction of truth supplies the resisting claim that the event answers.
One thing striking another supplies the event's material collision.
A rebuke that strikes the hearer supplies the impact's corrective social force.

structural_cues: The title al-haqqah is renamed al-qariah precisely in the clause reporting denial.
The following paired histories render refutation through consequences rather than debate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, striking, rebuke, and the focus's contested-claim branches; I infer that impact adjudicates the dispute, while an alternative is that al-qariah is only a parallel name with no legal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Truth wins at the level of proposition.
changed_reading.after: Truth wins by becoming the collision through which denial experiences its own refutation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same overstepping root spans rebellious excess, overwhelming punishment, and overflowing water. Against the focus's due-obligation branch, destruction reads as crossed measure returning as a due consequence through forces that themselves overrun limits.

activation_trace.role: A binding due supplies the consequence owed after a limit has been exceeded.
Falling into annihilation supplies the terminal result of the returned debt.
The non-dominant split branch's overwhelming punishment turns excess into the force that answers excess.
Water rising beyond its limit supplies a material image of measure breached and consequence released.

structural_cues: The destruction sequence repeatedly pairs communal refusal with an excessive natural or punitive force.
The root t-gh-y recurs across punishment in 69:5 and floodwater in 69:11.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excess, flood, punishment, annihilation, and due obligation; I supply the reversible arrow from crossed limit to owed consequence, while a live alternative treats the repeated root as intensity without moral measure.

changed_reading.before: The due event arrives because its date is fixed.
changed_reading.after: The due event is accumulated boundary-debt returning through an answering excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact counts, uninterrupted completion, repeated singleness, and final occurrence constrain the destructive imagery. The matured due is calibrated: a counted sequence completes, then singular acts make the event fall and stand.

activation_trace.role: Reaching due bearing time supplies maturation toward a determinate threshold.
Exact fit supplies calibration rather than indiscriminate catastrophe.
The literal count seven fixes the first span of the completed sequence.
The literal count eight fixes the second span and sharpens measured duration.
Uninterrupted succession turns separate counts into one completed temporal run.
Numerical oneness supplies the single decisive impulse after the extended count.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the transition from schedule to accomplished event.

structural_cues: Seven nights and eight days are followed by one blast and one leveling.
The cognate verb and noun in 69:15 mark the point at which measured preparation becomes occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact numbers, continuous succession, singleness, and occurrence; I infer calibration and completion, while the alternative is that these quantities describe separate scenes without defining the title's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The event is an undifferentiated overwhelming instant.
changed_reading.after: The event is a measured culmination whose spans and decisive acts arrive exactly fitted to their due time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Branches of tight weaving, demolition to levelness, splitting, and structural weakness set up a contrast: the focus names what is truly firm by exposing the world's apparently firm architecture as provisional and unmaking its joins.

activation_trace.role: Tight-made firmness supplies the standard against which cosmic cohesion is tested.
A fitted joint or socket supplies the material analogy of a world whose parts can be unseated.
Tight weaving gives the mountains a constructed firmness that can be reversed.
Pounding and demolition to levelness supply the unmaking of terrestrial structure.
Splitting open supplies the failure of the upper structure's continuity.
Relaxation and weakness expose prior cosmic firmness as non-final.

structural_cues: Earth and mountains are jointly carried and reduced by one blow before the sky splits.
The sequence moves from lower supports to the upper enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies firmness, leveling, splitting, and weakness; I infer a contrast between fixed truth and provisional cosmic fit, while the alternative is a destruction tableau with no lexical contrast to the title.

changed_reading.before: The event confirms the existing order's deepest stability.
changed_reading.after: The event distinguishes true firmness from created fit by unseating and unweaving the latter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal presentation, removal of hiddenness, binding records, and reckoning give the truth-making baseline an auditable procedure. The event makes persons and claims inspectable, then lets the written account carry judgment.

activation_trace.role: Contesting claims provide the matter placed under public adjudication.
Making truth visible supplies the adjudication's evidentiary result.
Bringing something out for inspection supplies the public presentation stage.
Removing concealment supplies the transition from hidden history to available evidence.
A written fixation that imposes judgment turns remembered conduct into binding record.
Counting and reckoning supply the procedure by which the record is resolved.

structural_cues: The universal passive presentation and doubled hiddenness formula precede the two handed-book speeches.
Both outcomes are narrated in first-person reactions to a personal account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, removal of concealment, binding writing, and calculation; I infer an audit-like adjudicative chain, while the alternative is display followed by reward and punishment without a procedural relation.

changed_reading.before: Truth is made manifest in a general cosmic sense.
changed_reading.after: Truth becomes a public audit in which hidden lives are exposed, written, counted, and adjudicated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's owned-right branch is activated by right-hand entitlement, what was advanced beforehand, and fulfillment of a right. Outcomes read as settlement of accrued claims: prior action advances value that returns when the due account is discharged.

activation_trace.role: A particular owned right supplies the claim that can accrue and later be settled.
Due obligation supplies the moment when the accrued claim becomes enforceable.
Right-hand force and right supply an embodied sign of established entitlement.
Value advanced beforehand supplies the temporal direction from prior acts to returned outcome.
Performance and full receipt of a right supply the settlement endpoint, even as the speaker wishes only for finality.

structural_cues: The favorable command explicitly grounds enjoyment in what was sent ahead in former days.
Right and left book deliveries create paired distributions around one account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entitlement, advance value, due obligation, and fulfillment of right; I infer a settlement relation between prior act and outcome, while the alternative is moral causality without any transactional texture.

changed_reading.before: The event imposes one universal obligation from above.
changed_reading.after: The event settles particular claims already accrued by each person's prior acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The discourse-provenance sequence moves from delivered speech, through the possibility of fabricated attribution, to seizure, severing of the life artery, and absence of any barrier. The title's tightly made truth therefore also acts as an integrity constraint on the speech that announces it.

activation_trace.role: Tight, sound speech supplies the focus-side model of verbal integrity.
Verification and making truth prevail supply enforcement of that integrity.
Delivering something down to its recipient supplies the asserted provenance chain.
Attributing speech that did not exist supplies the precise counterfactual breach.
Decisively settling an affair or right makes cutting function as immediate enforcement.
The artery of life locates enforcement at the speaker's sustaining interior.
Interposition by a separating barrier supplies the protection explicitly denied to any intervener.

structural_cues: The oath over visible and invisible things leads into exclusions of poet and soothsayer before naming the speech's descent.
The fabricated-speech condition forms one uninterrupted if-then sequence ending with no possible blocker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provenance, false attribution, vital severing, and failed interposition; I infer a truth-enforcing integrity constraint linking the title to its announcing speech, while the alternative confines the sequence to messenger validation alone.

changed_reading.before: The title names only the future reality described by the speech.
changed_reading.after: The title also names the integrity principle already policing the speech that discloses that reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent branches for regret as removal of a cover, unbelief as covering truth, and truth joined to settled certainty create a reversal: what was covered becomes the very thing that strips covering away until doubt cannot remain.

activation_trace.role: Truth fixed against falsehood supplies what persists beneath and after concealment.
Making truth visible supplies the active reversal of covering.
Removing a covering activates exposure within the verse's affective term for regret.
Covering truth supplies the concealment that the event reverses.
The returning truth root makes fixed actuality explicit at the sequence's end.
Stable knowledge after doubt supplies the terminal cognitive condition of full uncovering.

structural_cues: Regret for the coverers is immediately followed by haqq al-yaqin.
Earlier formulas of nothing hidden and both seen and unseen prepare the same concealment axis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cover, uncovering, fixed truth, and certainty; I infer a concealment-reversal mechanism, while the live alternative keeps hasrah only as regret and reads the branch overlap as non-operative.

changed_reading.before: The event proves an independently existing truth.
changed_reading.after: The event is an uncovering reversal in which covered truth strips away its coverers' uncertainty.

activation_trace.role: Straight inward penetration anchors the torrent image back in the title's own root inventory.
Abundant issuing from a source supplies disclosure as an overpowering flow rather than a definition.
A disturbed water vortex supplies cognition being drawn into what exceeds stable inspection.
Knowledge supplies the semantic control that keeps the torrent an epistemic analogy.

changed_reading.before: The question asks for missing information about the event.
changed_reading.after: The event's disclosure is imagined as a penetrating torrent or vortex that overwhelms ordinary knowing as it supplies it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a technical camel-age branch is carried into cosmic and moral load-bearing. It remains anchored in the focus inventory and is activated by three ordered uses of حمل with sharply different bearers; downstream prose should present it as a material capacity analogy, not as the lexical definition of الحاقة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus branch of reaching an age fit to carry is tested against repeated carrying in 69:11, 69:14, and 69:17.

activation_trace.role: Due bearing age supplies a threshold at which capacity for a load becomes manifest.
Lifting a visible load supplies the saving vessel as a bearer that holds.
Burden and hardship supply the carried earth and mountains as structures put under intolerable load.
Demolition to levelness supplies the failure result when the cosmic bearer does not hold.
Bearing an entrusted burden supplies the contrasting carriers who remain under the throne.

changed_reading.before: The due threshold concerns only when the event becomes ripe.
changed_reading.after: The due threshold is also a load test that reveals which vessel, world, or bearer can carry assigned weight.

It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by binding record, reckoning, and what was advanced; downstream prose should qualify it as an exact-track analogy for recompense, not an etymological claim about the title.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory's matched-step horse image is read alongside the personal record and prior acts.

activation_trace.role: A hind hoof landing in the fore hoof's place supplies exact consequence matching precedent.
Binding written fixation preserves the prior track against which the outcome can match.
Exact counting supplies the comparison between recorded precedent and returned consequence.
What precedes supplies the earlier footprint on which the later outcome lands.

changed_reading.before: The event distributes outcomes according to a general standard.
changed_reading.after: The event makes each outcome land in the exact track laid down by the act that preceded it.

strongest_changes: The interrogative repetition and knowledge root turn an opaque title into an event that creates the knowledge initially withheld.
Denial plus striking recasts truth as an experienced adjudication rather than a proposition.
Exact counts, singular blows, records, and reckoning make the due event calibrated and auditable rather than indiscriminate.
The late cover-uncover-certainty sequence makes al-haqqah an operation that reverses concealment.
The speech counterfactual extends truth-enforcement from the future event into the integrity of the discourse announcing it.
summary.what_was_special: A single-word focus supported coexisting legal, epistemic, kinetic, structural, temporal, and material models. The most productive surprises came from retaining split mappings and remote but packet-attested branches as contained activators: cognition as torrent, due time as load-bearing capacity, and recompense as an exactly matched track.
remaining_uncertainties: The title's feminine nominal form does not by itself decide whether it names an event, an agentive truth-maker, or a quality made concrete.
The closing haqq al-yaqin may identify the revelation or discourse more directly than the opening title, so their closure relation remains abductive.
The load, socket, weaving, torrent, and matched-hoof models are branch-driven analogies and must not be promoted into lexical glosses.
The settlement model may be moral causality without the stronger transactional structure inferred from owned right and advance value.
